Public Advisory: Illegal Online Betting

This office has received several complaints regarding illegal satta matka and online betting rackets operating in the district. Under the Public Gambling Act, 1867 and relevant Sections of the Information Technology Act, operating, promoting or participating in satta matka, teen patti or online rummy for real money is a punishable offence.

In a recent operation, the Cyber Crime Cell arrested three persons for running an illegal satta matka betting racket and registered an FIR under the relevant Sections. Bank accounts linked to the racket have been seized as part of the investigation.

This advisory notification is issued to warn citizens that teen patti and online rummy apps offering real money betting are also covered under the prohibition, and anyone found violating it will be booked and prosecuted under the Act.

Such platforms are banned in this state. Citizens are advised to report any information about satta matka operators to the Cyber Crime Cell helpline rather than engage with such platforms.

Services

  • Online complaint registration for cyber fraud and financial crime.
  • Awareness sessions for schools and colleges on safe internet use.
  • Verification of suspicious mobile applications and websites reported by citizens.

Notices

  • Helpline hours have been extended to cover weekends.
  • A new complaint tracking portal will be launched next month.
  • Citizens are urged to verify lending and betting applications before installing them.
